title: Mihoko Otake, Team Director of the Cognitive Behavioral Assistive Technology Team, Receives the Women in AI APAC Awards 2026 – AI for Social Good Award
sourceName: RIKEN Center for Advanced Intelligence Project
content: Mihoko Otake, Team Director of the Cognitive Behavioral Assistive Technology Team, has received the Women in AI APAC Awards 2026 – AI for Social Good Award. The Women in AI APAC Awards, organized by the non-profit organization Women in AI (WAI), recognize women across the Asia-Pacific region who have made outstanding achievements and innovations in artificial intelligence. Every year, around 200 applications are received, and approximately 20 individuals are recognized across award categories. The AI for Social Good Award honors initiatives that use AI to address societal challenges and create positive impact for communities. The award recognizes Mihoko Otake’s research and social implementation activities in Cognitive Behavioral Assistive Technology. The Cognitive Behavioral Assistive Technology Team develops technologies that help maintain and enhance cognitive reserve to prevent cognitive decline and dementia in older adults. The team develops conversational support technologies and AI-based communication support systems and evaluates their effects on human cognition and well-being.
